#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    int n;
    
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int outer = 0, inner = 0;
    int current = 0;
    bool inParens = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        
        if (c == '(') {
            if (current > 0) outer = std::max(outer, current);
            current = 0;
            inParens = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (current > 0) inner++;
            current = 0;
            inParens = false;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (inParens) {
                if (current > 0) inner++;
                current = 0;
            } else {
                if (current > 0) outer = std::max(outer, current);
                current = 0;
            }
        } else {
            current++;
        }
    }
    
    if (current > 0) outer = std::max(outer, current);
    
    std::cout << outer << " " << inner << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
